title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ).

title: Role of Lambda in Ridge Regression
text: The regularization parameter lambda (λ) in ridge regression helps to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the size of coefficients. When $$\lambda=0$$, the penalty term is removed.

title: Effect of $$Lambda=0$$
text: When $$\lambda=0$$, ridge regression becomes ordinary least squares regression. In this case, the model may not have a unique solution if the data is not full rank.
